body: US airlines expect to carry nearly 29 million passengers over the 2026 Thanksgiving travel weekend, with the biggest crowds due as travelers head home from family celebrations. Airlines for America expects November 29 and 30 to be the two busiest days of the 11-day period that begins November 20, and US carriers are offering an average of 38,000 more seats per day than they did over Thanksgiving last year.

American Airlines has scheduled 7,021 flights for November 29, its busiest day since the pandemic. American and its regional partners expect more than 8 million passengers across nearly 85,000 flights between November 19 and December 1, with 4% more flights than last Thanksgiving, and at midday on November 29 American expects to have 1,130 flights in the air at once. United Airlines expects to carry more than 6.6 million passengers over the same 13 days, forecasts more than 540,000 passengers on Friday, November 20, and expects about 600,000 passengers on November 29.

Last year's screening figures show the scale of the return rush. The Sunday after Thanksgiving in 2025 was the busiest day the Transportation Security Administration (TSA) had ever recorded: TSA screened more than 3.13 million people at US airports on November 30, more than twice the 1.56 million who passed through checkpoints on Thanksgiving Day, and nearly 2.9 million more passed through security on December 1. Los Angeles International (LAX) handled the most checkpoint traffic during the seven days around Thanksgiving last year, with about 689,000 people, followed by 647,000 at New York's John F. Kennedy International (JFK), 603,000 at Atlanta (ATL) and 598,000 at Chicago O'Hare (ORD). Booking platform Hopper put the average domestic round-trip fare for travelers returning November 29 at $604, a hefty premium over the same flights at less busy times of the year.
en.summary: US airlines expect to carry nearly 29 million passengers over the 2026 Thanksgiving travel period; American Airlines has scheduled 7,021 flights for November 29, its busiest day since the pandemic, while United expects about 600,000 passengers that day.

body: 美國航空業者預期2026年感恩節連假疏運近2900萬人次，返程人潮最為集中。航空運輸協會（Airlines for America）預期11月29日與30日為自11月20日起的11天疏運期中最繁忙的兩天，美國業者每日平均座位數較去年感恩節增加3.8萬個。
美國航空11月29日排定7021個航班，為疫情以來最繁忙的一天；11月19日至12月1日期間，美國航空與區域夥伴預期疏運逾800萬人次、近8.5萬個航班，航班數較去年感恩節增加4%，11月29日中午同時在空中的美國航空航班預期達1130架。聯合航空同一13天期間預期疏運逾660萬人次，11月20日星期五預期逾54萬人次，11月29日當天約60萬人次。

去年感恩節的安檢數字顯示返程人潮規模：2025年11月30日運輸安全管理局（TSA）安檢逾313萬人次，為TSA史上最繁忙的一天，約為感恩節當天156萬人次的兩倍，12月1日另有近290萬人次通過安檢；感恩節前後七天，洛杉磯國際機場（LAX）安檢約68.9萬人次居全美之冠，其次為紐約甘迺迪國際機場（JFK）64.7萬人次、亞特蘭大（ATL）60.3萬人次與芝加哥歐海爾（ORD）59.8萬人次。訂房平台Hopper統計，11月29日返程的美國國內來回機票均價為604美元，較一年中較不繁忙時段明顯偏高。
